name: Multiversal Passage

covers.line: As ~ enters, choose a basic land type. Then you may pay 2 life. If you don't, it enters tapped.

notes: The as-enters half is declared (choose a basic land type, then the shockland pay-2-life-or-tapped), but NO covers kind can claim its oracle line: COVER_RULES.asEnters has no shape for "As ~ enters, choose a basic land type." and none for a line that carries the choice and the pay-life clause together, so that line stays unparsed however the face is written. The type-change layer is the doc-sanctioned script-only shape (layers.md limit 2): the land matches the chosen type for filters and landwalk but gains no mana ability.
